## Summary

An affiliate endorsement of a specific modafinil generic: **modvigil-200 by HAB Pharma**. His case: cheap; consistent ("never fails me"); high quality; "vetted manufacturer (in biz since 1989)" — the packaging OCR corroborates the HAB Pharma branding. "And i got them to give me a 40% discount. linked in comments" — the discount link sits in his replies (affiliate code), not in the tweet itself. Flavor: "it's a straight fucking shooter of 200 mg pure focus and performance, like a breath of fresh air after suffocating — i fucking love it."

## Why it matters

- This is the **"which brand, where from" layer** of RD's modafinil thread: the limitlesstack manual ([[2026-11-10-limitlesstack-modafinil-thesis]]) was the thesis (mechanism, dosing, cycling, SJS risk); this tweet names a concrete generic (modvigil-200 / HAB Pharma) plus a vendor-discount lane — the same shape as the Driada catalog entry that started the thread.
- The strongest fact in the tweet is the manufacturer vintage: HAB Pharma is a long-standing Indian generics house, and modvigil is its established modafinil brand — the "consistent, vetted manufacturer" claim is at least about a real company, not a phantom lab. Everything else is affiliate framing.
- Skepticism gates: the "negotiated" 40% discount is monetization — the reply-buried affiliate link is the point of the tweet, and it was not captured (anonymous lanes don't expose replies; an affiliate URL isn't vaulted as a recommendation regardless). Packaging photos are marketing shots, not assay results; "never fails me" is n=1. UAE posture unchanged from the 11-10 CoS guidance: modafinil is prescription-controlled and gray-market imports carry customs-seizure risk. Reference-only, no task — RD's stance on this thread remains checking, not ordering.
